text: The basin fills up because water will not drain away.
A puddle forms under the kitchen pipe every time I wash dishes.
Turning the bathroom tap produces only a few drops.
The toilet cistern runs continuously after flushing.
There is no hot water for our showers.
The shower drain smells bad and bubbles when the sink empties.
Every time I use the kettle the power trips.
The bedroom socket stopped supplying electricity.
The ceiling light flashes on and off.
I noticed sparks at an outlet near the cooker.
My prepaid meter screen has gone blank.
One plug is warm and smells burnt.
I cannot secure the front door because the lock is damaged.
My access keys disappeared on my way home.
Someone broke the burglar bars at my window.
The gate remote will not open the entrance.
The front door was forced and I do not feel safe.
The padlock is broken and anybody can enter the property.
The cupboard hinge has come away from its door.
Paint is flaking from the lounge wall.
A floor tile has lifted up in the hallway.
The garden needs someone to cut the overgrown grass.
The curtain rail came loose above the window.
There is a hole in the interior bedroom door.
